title: FairITR: Fairness-Aware Learning of Multicategory Individualized Treatment Rules
abstract: arXiv:2611.27894v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Individualized treatment rules (ITRs) recommend treatment decisions based on individual characteristics and can improve treatment outcomes beyond traditional one-size-fits-all strategies. However, similar to other commonly used algorithmic decision-making methods, ITRs without considering model fairness may result in unfair decisions across groups defined by sensitive attributes, such as race or gender. Although extensive methods have been developed for ITR estimation, most focus solely on optimizing treatment outcomes, while research on fairness-aware ITRs remains limited. Moreover, the practical scenario of multicategory treatments is rarely considered in existing fair ITR studies. To address these gaps, we introduce a fairness notion for multicategory ITRs that requires treatment decisions to be independent of sensitive attributes, and then formulate the corresponding problem of estimating fair ITRs. translated_title: FairITR：公平感知的多类别个体化治疗规则学习
translated_abstract: 个体化治疗规则（ITRs）基于个体特征推荐治疗决策，能够超越传统的“一刀切”策略改善治疗效果。然而，与其他常用的算法决策方法类似，未考虑模型公平性的ITRs可能会在由种族或性别等敏感属性定义的不同群体之间产生不公平的决策。尽管目前已发展出大量用于ITR估计的方法，但大多数仅专注于优化治疗效果，而关于公平感知ITR的研究仍然有限。此外，现有公平ITR研究很少考虑多类别治疗这一实际场景。为弥补这些空白，我们为多类别ITR引入了一种公平性概念，要求治疗决策独立于敏感属性，并据此构建了相应的公平ITR估计问题。为解决该问题，我们进一步（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出了FairITR，首次针对多类别治疗场景引入公平性概念——要求治疗决策独立于敏感属性，并构建了相应的公平个体化治疗规则估计问题及其求解方法。
